entries.text: benchbox run --quiet now prints the captured error output to stderr when the run fails, so a failed quiet run no longer exits without a message.

Heavy-work admission now requires a clean host for a hold window (BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT_HOLD_SECONDS, default 30; a non-finite or negative value is refused), and the watchdog reports the largest processes outside a breaching tree with their command lines redacted and container runtime processes on a separate line, without changing what it kills.
